description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'Utils' with helper methods for map operations and number parsing, used within the Rusefi project.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling maps and parsing integers.

methods.name: findClosest
methods.description: Finds the key in a TreeMap that is closest to the specified value.

methods.name: getOrCreate
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a map by key or creates and inserts it if absent.

methods.description: Parses a string to an integer with error handling, adding context to exceptions.
